Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities on human single-protein target CHEMBL1250344 (Serine palmitoyltransferase 2). Filter to exact standard relation '=' rows with non-null pChEMBL values. Join activities to assays and target_dictionary, and join activities to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to the first 1000 rows.
